import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+x]))
    a.sort()
    if x == 1:
        print(a[0])
    else:
        if x % 2 == 0:
            print(a[x % 2 - 1])
        elif x == 5:
            print(a[(x % 2) + 1])
        else:
            print(a[x % 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
